title: PlotManager
features:
Auto-Shop - Scans shops and buys matching wanted units.

Auto-Merchant - Scans merchant offers and buys wanted items.

Auto-Lure - Repeatedly uses selected boss lures.

Auto-Enchant - Rolls enchants without needing inventory open.

Evolution - Evolves selected unit using selected item.

Loadouts - Saves and applies full plot setups.

Target Modes - Sets slot target type manually or through loadouts.

Manual Plot Control - Places or removes units from selected slots.

Plot Scanner - Guesses other plots; outdated but mostly works.

Wave Controls - Buys or selects waves from dropdowns.

Difficulty Selector - Sets Easy, Normal, or Hard.

Daily Rewards - Claims daily reward manually or automatically.

Config Manager - Saves, loads, overwrites, and autoloads settings.

Theme Settings - Manages UI appearance and themes.

Owned Data Tools - Copies owned data and current slot map.
